title: 경찰제복 및 경찰장비의 규제에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: National Police Agency ( Equipment Officer ), 02-3150-1252

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「경찰제복 및 경찰장비의 규제에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Regulation of Police Uniforms and Police Equipment and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(경찰장비의 범위) ① 「경찰제복 및 경찰장비의 규제에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제2호에서 “경찰의 직무수행을 위하여 필요한 장비 중 행정안전부령으로 정한 것”이란 다음 각 호의 장비를 말한다. <개정 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Police Equipment) ① The phrase “equipment necessary for the performance of police duties among those prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” in Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act on the Regulation of Police Uniforms and Equipment (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)refers to the equipment set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 경찰수갑
rows.text_en: 1. Police handcuffs

rows.source_ko: 2. 경찰방패
rows.text_en: 2. Police shield

rows.source_ko: 3. 경찰권총 허리띠
rows.text_en: 3. Police pistol belt

rows.source_ko: 4. 경찰차량 및 이륜차(경광등 및 도색ㆍ표시만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Police vehicles and motorcycles (only flashing lights and paint/markings apply)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 각 호의 장비에 관한 구체적인 기준은 별표 1에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② Specific standards for the equipment in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 shall be in accordance with Annex 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(등록신청서 등) 법 제3조제1항에 따라 경찰제복이나 경찰장비의 제조 또는 판매업(이하 “제조ㆍ판매업”이라 한다)을 하려는 자가 「경찰제복 및 경찰장비의 규제에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제3조제1항에 따라 제출하여야 하는 제조ㆍ판매업 등록신청서와 제조ㆍ판매업의 등록을 한 자가 영 제4조제1항에 따라 제출하여야 하는 제조ㆍ판매업 변경등록 신청서는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Registration, etc.) The application for registration of a manufacturing or sales business that a person intending to engage in the business of manufacturing or selling police uniforms or police equipment (hereinafter referred to as “manufacturing and sales business”)submit pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Regulation of Police Uniforms and Police Equipment (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”),the application for change of registration of a manufacturing or sales business that a person who has registered a manufacturing or sales business must submit pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Decree, shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(등록취소 및 영업정지의 처분기준) 법 제5조제1항에 따른 제조ㆍ판매업의 등록취소 및 영업정지에 관한 행정처분기준은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Criteria for Cancellation of Registration and Suspension of Business) The criteria for administrative dispositions regarding the cancellation of registration and suspension of business of manufacturing and sales businesses pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제5조(등록증 및 등록대장) ① 영 제5조제1항 전단에 따른 제조ㆍ판매업 등록증은 별지 제2호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Registration Certificate and Registration Register) ①The registration certificate for manufacturing and sales business pursuant to the first part of Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Register .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제5조제1항 후단에 따른 제조ㆍ판매업 등록대장은 별지 제3호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The register of manufacturing and sales businesses pursuant to the latter part of Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제5조제2항에 따른 제조ㆍ판매업 등록증 재발급 신청서는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The application for reissuance of a manufacturing and sales business registration certificate pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(제조ㆍ판매장부) ① 제조ㆍ판매업자가 법 제6조제1항에 따라 사업장에 비치하여야 할 제조ㆍ판매 장부는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Manufacturing and Sales Ledger) ① The manufacturing and sales ledger that a manufacturer or sellermust keep at their workplace pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 제조ㆍ판매 장부는 1년간 보존하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The manufacturing and sales ledgers pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be preserved for one year.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 52, Dec. 30, 2015>

rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on December 31, 2015.

rows.text_en: In the format and marking column of Item 1(a) of Annex 1, the classification column of Item 2(b) of the same table, and Item 5 of the same table, “Korea Coast Guard Headquarters” shall be changed to “Korea Coast Guard”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식 앞쪽, 같은 서식 뒤쪽 처리절차란, 별지 제2호서식 및 별지 제4호서식 중 “○○안전본부장”을 각각 “○○해양지방경찰청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the front of Form No. 1, the processing procedure column at the back of the same form, and in Forms No. 2 and No. 4, “Head of the ○○ Safety Headquarters” shall be changed to “Head of the ○○ Regional Maritime Police Agency” respectively.
